title: Structure spotted in NASA Mars photo hailed as 'proof' of alien life
excerpt: A mysterious structure has been spotted hiding in a Mars photo taken by NASA's rover that is currently searching the Red Planet for signs of ancient life.
content:
As NASA searches Mars for signs of ancient life, one UFO researcher believes clues have been hiding in plain sight.

The space agency’s Perseverance rover captured the panorama in 2022, showing a rocky outcrop called Alagnak in the ancient river delta inside Jezero Crater.

The images document the Martian landscape, but UFO researcher Scott C Waring believes they contain ‘proof’ of an ancient alien civilization.

Posting on his website UFO Sightings Daily last week, Waring pointed to what he described as a seven-foot-tall doorway leading into an ‘adobe-like house’ atop a hill.

The formation sits toward the back of the panorama, with what appears to be a rectangular opening at its front.

Nearby, Waring claimed to have spotted a fallen green-blue statue resembling an ‘alien god,’ whose unusual coloring stood out from the surrounding terrain.

He also identified what he believed were tools, bones and sculptures scattered across the landscape.

‘If it were just one object, it might be an unusual coincidence,’ Waring wrote, arguing that finding ‘a dozen signs of intelligent life is something else entirely.’

NASA's Perseverance rover captured the panorama in 2022, showing a rocky outcrop called Alagnak in the ancient river delta inside Jezero Crater

The images document the Martian landscape, but UFO researcher Scott C Waring believes they contain ‘proof’ of an ancient alien civilization. Posting on his website UFO Sightings Daily last week, Waring pointed to what he described as a seven-foot-tall doorway leading into an ‘adobe-like house’ atop a hill.

However, NASA has maintained that it has no evidence of extraterrestrial life and has yet to find any signs of current or past life on Mars.

Regardless, Waring posted: 'Proof of ancient alien civilization on Mars in NASA rover photo.'

Waring also pointed to the supposed statue’s coloring as another reason he believed the formation deserved attention.

‘The statue has a unique color that appears nowhere else in this photo,’ he wrote. ‘Nothing around it matches its unique coloration.’

He ended by encouraging readers to inspect the panorama themselves, asking: ‘Why doesn’t NASA report finding these things?’

Waring has been sharing bizarrely shaped rocks on the Red Planet for about a decade, with another discovery in October.

A Mars photo captured by NASA's Curiosity shows what he believes was another doorway, specifically an ancient gateway left by a lost civilization.

Sharing a close-up of the site, he circled the feature resembling a tall, narrow doorway in the face of a jagged rock, with a dark center, tapered top and uneven stone edges giving it the appearance of a ‘portal' - as he wrote on the image.

He also identified what he believed were tools, bones and sculptures scattered across the landscape

'I found some ancient runes in a Mars photo today,' Waring shared on his website UFO Sightings Daily.

He also claimed to have found another formation supporting his claim about a lost civilization on the Red Planet.

'A tiny doorway that measures about 7 inches high and 5 inches wide and enters a pyramid-shaped object,' Waring wrote.

The mosaic shows boulders inside Jezero Crater, where NASA’s Perseverance rover was exploring in June 2021 using its Mastcam-Z cameras.

It is labeled Sol 107, referring to the 107th Martian day of the mission. Jezero once held a lake billions of years ago, making it a key location in the search for signs of ancient microbial life.

UFO researcher Scott Waring shared the photo online, showing a stunning view of the Mars landscape littered with large boulders, and pointed to what he said was a portal

He also included a shot of what he believes is a doorway among the rocks

In August, Waring posted another photo snapped by NASA's Curiosity rover on Mars in May 2022, which he and many others were sure contained a doorway.

The photograph appears to show a dark, rectangular opening cut into a rocky hill, which some observers have compared to the doorway of a primitive dwelling.

‘The entrance is approximately 6.6 feet tall and 3.3 feet wide, about the size of a doorway in an Earth home,’ Waring said.

He questioned why the rover did not approach the feature and speculated that NASA may have already investigated it without releasing the results publicly.

Waring did not explain how he calculated the alleged doorway’s dimensions or provide evidence that the space agency conducted a secret investigation.

Its actual size cannot be reliably determined from the panorama alone without knowing its precise distance from Curiosity or identifying a nearby object that could provide scale.

In August, Waring posted a photo snapped by NASA's Curiosity rover on Mars in May 2022, which Waring and many others were sure contained a doorway 

The apparent entrance could therefore be significantly smaller, or larger, than Waring’s estimate.

NASA has not commented on the latest claims, but the agency addressed remarkably similar speculation after Curiosity photographed another door-shaped feature on Mars in May 2022.

That opening initially appeared large enough for a person to walk through, fueling theories that it was evidence of an artificial structure hidden within Mount Sharp.

Closer analysis revealed that it measured only approximately 12 inches tall and 16 inches wide, roughly the size of a dog door.

‘The mound, on Mount Sharp, has a number of naturally occurring open fractures,’ NASA explained at the time. ‘These kinds of open fractures are common in bedrock, both on Earth and on Mars.’

Scientists determined that the earlier ‘doorway’ was a small opening created where intersecting fractures caused pieces of rock to break away.
